goal: prompts/summarize.txt scores at least 36 of 40 on benchmarks/dev/ and its held-out score is reported; done when reports/benchmark.md shows both numbers

steps.title: Run the baseline on the dev set
steps.proof: npm run bench -- benchmarks/dev writes reports/rounds/round-0.json with a score out of 40

steps.title: Validate the benchmark script against five hand-marked cases
steps.proof: reports/metric-check.md shows npm run bench gives the same pass or fail as the hand marks on all 5 cases

steps.title: Score the dev set
steps.proof: npm run bench -- benchmarks/dev output saved as reports/rounds/round-N.json

steps.title: Tune the prompt from the failed cases
steps.proof: prompts/summarize.txt changed and the diff names the failed case ids it targets

steps.title: Run the held-out set once
steps.proof: npm run bench -- benchmarks/held_out writes reports/held-out.json with a score out of 20, run once

steps.title: Write the benchmark report
steps.proof: reports/benchmark.md lists the score for every round, the held-out score and the gap between dev and held-out

loops.until: Dev score is at least 36 of 40, or the score has not risen for two rounds
loops.heldOut: The 20 cases in benchmarks/held_out/, run once by held-out after the loop
